description: We are the team Sievert Squad who will be taking you on a journey explaining every steps of doing what it takes to live on the moon and in the future, Mars. We have explained every problem you will face there and how to survive them. And for everyone's welfare and higher success rates, we have built our own solution through a website and a game.
summary: Our game, AstroVive is a free, extremely simple offline game. Everyone can play it whenever and whereever they like. The player is controled by WASD keys or arrow keys. They player must balance an outpost. He will face various challenges which could harm the mission and risk his life. He must survive various demands such as Food, Oxygen, water, shielding, and many more. The player can choose to manage a lunar, or martian outpost. as a result, he can get an experience of different environments on different planets. This game solves a crucial mission, which is survival on the moon/mars. He will learn how to survive on there as well as manage resources, tasks, supplies, etc and how to survive different disasters. In the future, our game will be upgraded so that its even more accurate and better as well as more engaging for students.
